Dear Ms. Fuchsreiter,

Thank you for your quote and for the openness with which you work with us. We value the years of cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

To be open with you, our comparison looks different:

Another supplier has offered EUR 36.00 for this part (offer:70210-0).

Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70250@2026Q3).

Because we want to keep this partnership strong, we have prepared two genuine options. Option A is built around faster payment, Option B gives you a somewhat longer payment term at a slightly higher price.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 27.66; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 27.82; payment 30 days net; lead time 35 days.

We would be glad to find the right solution together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
